profile.headline: Senior Software Developer
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience designing, developing, and modernizing enterprise applications across the full software development lifecycle. Experienced building full-stack solutions using React, TypeScript, Java Spring Boot, and .NET Core, with cloud-native deployments on Kubernetes and OpenShift. Background in distributed systems, microservices, REST APIs, event-driven architecture, and production support. Focused on maintainable software, system reliability, and cross-functional delivery.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design, develop, and modernize enterprise applications supporting Wells Fargo’s small business and personal card platform. Work across the technology stack on cloud-native solutions, distributed microservices, event-driven architecture, and production support.
- Develop full-stack applications using React, TypeScript, Java Spring Boot, and .NET Core for commercial business card platforms serving approximately 10,000 daily users.
- Contribute to modernization of legacy .NET applications into cloud-native React applications and Java microservices to improve maintainability and long-term scalability.
- Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs secured with OAuth and documented using Swagger/OpenAPI.
- Build and enhance distributed microservices using Spring Boot, MongoDB, Kafka, and Redis for transactional workloads exceeding 7,000 transactions per hour.
- Deploy and support applications on OpenShift and Kubernetes, managing deployments, ConfigMaps, YAML manifests, scaling, and production troubleshooting.
- Maintain GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows and support automated testing and enterprise deployments.
- Monitor production systems with Splunk and AppDynamics and participate in incident investigation and resolution. - Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, sprint planning, and cross-functional collaboration.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · TypeScript · MongoDB · Node.js · React

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Contributed to the design, development, and maintenance of enterprise inventory management and analytics applications across multiple business domains. Worked throughout the software development lifecycle while supporting production environments in an Agile setting.
- Designed and developed inventory management applications using React, TypeScript, .NET Core, SQL Server, and Azure.
- Built responsive user interfaces and reusable components to improve user experience and simplify future feature development.
- Developed RESTful APIs supporting search, analytics, and inventory management functionality.
- Improved application performance by approximately 20% through API optimization, query improvements, and front-end enhancements.
- Reduced software defects through unit testing, code reviews, and Agile development practices.
- Participated in requirements analysis, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · .NET Framework · .NET Core · Internet Information Services (IIS) · TFS · React.js · JavaScript · TypeScript · Visual Basic .NET (VB.NET) · HTML5 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Microsoft SQL Server · REST APIs · npm · Agile Methodologies · jQuery · Continuous Integration (CI) · Web Development · Software Testing

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained enterprise warehouse management applications supporting internal logistics and inventory operations. Worked across frontend, backend, database, and cloud technologies while participating in application modernization and deployment improvements.
- Developed warehouse inventory applications using Angular, Java, C#, Azure, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, and MySQL.
- Participated in enterprise application modernization and migration efforts to improve maintainability and deployment efficiency.
- Designed and implemented RESTful APIs supporting inventory management and warehouse operations.
- Automated software delivery using Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines.
- Increased internal productivity by approximately 25% through enhancements to warehouse management applications.
- Improved database retrieval performance by 15–25% through backend service and database optimization.
- Created and maintained technical documentation to support application maintenance and knowledge transfer.
positions.insights: Skills: Scrum · C# · User Experience (UX) · React · Creative Problem Solving · JUnit · Front-End Development · JavaScript · Angular · Azure DevOps · Spring Boot · Jest · TypeScript · Spring Framework · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Java · Teamwork · Continuous Integration (CI) · Data Structures · Web Development · Quarkus · REST APIs · Maven · Software Testing · Microsoft Azure · Angular Material
